title: berman.software/1
description: The installed package's identity, as printed by berman version, kept in software.json and retained in each new operation record. source_sha256 and files_sha256 digest Berman's own installed files. environment is absent from records made before version 0.4.2, which declared no dependencies; its versions name releases, not bytes, and no qualification rests on them.

dependencies.description: Installed version of each distribution the declared dependencies require; null when one is not installed.

sha256.description: a SHA-256 digest in lowercase hexadecimal
